raw.body:
There's been an influx of PRs attempting to fix inconsistent operations by just removing the throw when reconciling the operations with the store.

Throwing in the store has always led to discovery of a backend bug so we should never stop throwing for general case.

I've added a comment for all the throwAndEmit when we handle operations in the store. Hopefully that triggers LLMs to re-attempt the fix.
raw.title: [devtools] Document that Store consistency throws must not be worked around
